- Option B: Wed 19 Aug, 08:30–09:30 PT (allows APAC observers, tight for infra)
- Option C: Thu 20 Aug, 13:00–14:00 PT (customer prefered if available)

Attached are a draft agenda and the proposed MVP scope (Kickoff-Agenda-v1.pdf, MVP-scope.xlsx).

Please confirm who from Redwood will attend (suggested attendees below) and any constraints you want me to call out to the customer in the invite. I can include an operations runbook link in the calendar.

Can James or Ava share the expected peak sequence length and typical prompt/response length for the first two pipelines you want to evaluate? I'll prepare a 10-minute architecture overview focused on: auth, data flows (ingest -> embeddings -> inference), and a proposed timeline for the MVP (the workbook has a draft timeline).

See you on Tue.
